name: sdrift-pyatv-pyatv-003-shared
instr:
# Reconcile implementation and docs in pyatv

As maintainer of `pyatv` (a Python library for discovery and control of Apple TV and AirPlay devices), you've noticed the code at `/app` and its documentation
disagree in a few spots (the prose docs under `/app/docs/` and docstrings in `/app/pyatv/`, especially the deterministic support helpers). The documented contract is what callers rely on, so the code is
what's wrong. Make the implementation behave as documented.

Edit under `/app/pyatv/` only, keep public interfaces and file structure intact, add nothing new, stay
offline. Evaluation compares your code to the documented behaviour on held-out inputs (support collection, buffer, cache, URL, varint, device lookup, and discovery helper behavior).
